intro.header: I'm Debert, passionate software engineer and machine learning enthusiast.

texts.title: Curious Student with Free Time
texts.description: I started learning about programming when I was in middle school. Initially, I was not interested in school's IT curriculum that mostly focused on basic computer literacy and computer networking. The first project I worked on my free time was a simple Discord bot and it helped me understand the basics of programming, databases, and APIs.

texts.title: From Psychology To Programming
texts.description: During high school, I was interested in psychology and human behavior. I was fascinated by how people think and behave in different situations. Although I ended up not pursuing psychology as a career, I still find it interesting and like to read about it. Psychology helped me to open up and interact with people without feeling awkward or shy.

texts.title: Web Development 101
texts.description: During my last year of high school, I created a simple website that will soon develop into this personal website. That website helped me dive deeper into web development and learn more about React. After entering university, I migrated my website to Next.js and used debertjamie.com as my personal domain.

texts.title: Touching Grass
texts.description: Besides programming and studying, I also like photography and traveling (cliche, I know). I joined several communities and organizations in my university to meet new people and learn new things. In my second year I joined the university's freshman orientation committee and also employed as my major's academic tutor for first-year students. Sometimes I took photos of the scenery in the city or campus for fun.

texts.title: Today and Beyond
texts.description: Currently, I'm helping as a web developer for my department's biomedical engineering laboratory. I'm also learning more about cloud computing and human-computer interaction, aiming to create a better user experience and interface for projects I work on.

contents: My first machine learning project was a classification model to predict El Nino and La Nina events using basic mathematics, the Oceanic El Nino Index dataset, and a custom logistic regression model.
I am very passionate about teaching math topics such as calculus and algebra. You can ask me math-related questions and I will answer them when I have time!

I like to listen to music while doing daily activities, from songs in the early 2000s to the latest songs. It helps me relax and clear my mind, although sometimes I get distracted and start humming along.
